facts.fact: The profile states ANSSI, the national information systems security agency, was newly created in 2018 with Folané as its first director-general, tasked with protecting national cyberspace.

systems.system: Agence nationale de sécurité des systèmes d'information (ANSSI)

note: National strategy is said to have been drafted under him, not stated adopted; no incident, CII or figures.
